title: GitLab 6-hafta takrorlash - muhitlarga deploy
description: Environment’lar, SSH deploy, gate’lar, review app’lar va Kubernetes bo’yicha sakkiz savol.

w6-01.prompt: Deploy job’ga environment: qo’shib nimaga erishasiz?

options.text: Deploy kuzatuvi, URL tugmasi, tarix, rollback va environment scope’li variable’lar

w6-02.prompt: Variable staging va production’da bir nom ostida turli qiymatga ega bo’lishi kerak. Qaysi mexanizm?

options.text: Har job uchun job darajasidagi variables:

w6-02.explanation: Bir nomni har environment’ga scope’lang (review/* kabi wildcard’lar ishlaydi).

w6-03.prompt: Deploy job’da SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS nimadan himoya qiladi?

options.text: Soxta host ko’rsatadigan man-in-the-middle’dan - StrictHostKeyChecking=no uni qabul qilardi

w6-03.explanation: Host key’ni tekshiring; pipeline’da tekshiruvni hech qachon o’chirmang.

w6-04.prompt: Qaysi ikki kalit deploy job’ni bloklovchi manual gate’ga aylantiradi?
w6-04.explanation: allow_failure: false’siz pipeline manual job’dan o’tib ketadi.

w6-05.prompt: YAML’ida shunday job bo’lsa ham feature-branch pipeline’i production’ga deploy qilishini nima to’xtatadi?

options.text: Himoyalangan environment’lar (faqat himoyalangan ref’lardan, ruxsat berilgan foydalanuvchilar) plus himoyalangan branch’lar

w6-05.explanation: Himoya - YAML kelishuvi emas, platforma qoidasi.

w6-06.prompt: stop-review job’da nega GIT_STRATEGY: none o’rnatilgan?

options.text: U ishlaganda branch o’chirilgan bo’lishi mumkin; checkout’ga muhtoj bo’lmasligi kerak

w6-06.explanation: Stop job’lar merge/yopishda, ehtimol branch yo’qolgandan keyin ishlaydi.

w6-07.prompt: Kubeconfig variable’ga nisbatan Kubernetes uchun GitLab agent pipeline’dan nimani olib tashlaydi?

options.text: Variable’dagi uzoq umrli klaster hisob ma’lumotini va kiruvchi firewall teshigini

w6-07.explanation: Agent chiquvchi ulanadi va GitLab ruxsat berilgan loyihalar uchun scope’langan KUBECONFIG kiritadi.

w6-08.prompt: Nega shunchaki apply emas, helm --wait / kubectl rollout status?

options.text: Job exit kodi 'manifest qabul qilindi' emas, 'yangi pod’lar tayyor' degani bo’lsin
